intro: Carolina Heating Service provides HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and home generator service in Duncan, SC, with one licensed team handling repair, replacement, and maintenance across all four trades. Duncan sits in the middle of western Spartanburg County's growth along I-85, where new subdivisions and long-standing homes now share the same streets and need very different work.

The company has served the Upstate since 1981. Every diagnosis comes with documented findings, every quote is itemized before work starts, and scheduling runs through online booking or website chat staffed around the clock.

faqs.question: My Duncan home is only a few years old. Why schedule HVAC maintenance already?
faqs.answer: Most manufacturer warranties require documented annual service to stay enforceable, and a tune-up verifies what the builder's installer may not have, including refrigerant charge and airflow.

faqs.question: What size standby generator does a typical Duncan house need?
faqs.answer: It comes down to what you want powered during an outage. Essential circuits need far less capacity than whole-home coverage that includes air conditioning.

faqs.question: How do I know if my water pressure problem is the house or the utility?
faqs.answer: Pressure that is low at every fixture, hot and cold alike, points toward the supply side, the pressure reducing valve, or aging supply lines. Pressure that drops at one fixture points inside the house.

faqs.question: Does duct cleaning actually help with Upstate pollen?
faqs.answer: It helps with the pollen already inside. Spring pollen that enters the house settles into duct runs and returns to circulation every time the blower starts.

faqs.question: Which nearby communities do you serve?
faqs.answer: Greer, Woodruff, and Taylors all sit inside regular coverage, along with the rest of the Greenville and Spartanburg area.
